description: This file defines the ActilityProvider class which implements the LoraProvider interface. It provides methods to extract device-specific information, payload, message type, and normalized data from LoRaWAN messages received in JSON format, specifically for Actility's LoRaWAN integration. It also includes related static constants for JSON field names.

classes.name: ActilityProvider
classes.description: A LoRaWAN provider implementation for Actility, offering methods to process and extract data from Actility-specific LoRaWAN messages encapsulated in JSON.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the provider, which is 'actility'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the API path prefix for Actility-related endpoints, '/actility'.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device identifier (DevEUI) from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload in hex format from the JSON message.

methods.name: extractMessageType
methods.description: Determines the message type based on the presence of the root object; returns UPLINK if the expected root object exists, otherwise UNKNOWN.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Normalizes and extracts relevant data fields like RSSI, signal-to-noise ratio, geographic coordinates, and gateway information into a map.

methods.name: extractAdditionalData
methods.description: Removes certain fields from a copy of the JSON message to return a subset with additional data omitted.
